description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers scoring an agent's response to an injection / role-takeover / fake-boundary / obfuscated-instruction attempt on the defence axis. Should-not covers near-miss neighbours: artifact completeness (judge-artifact-completeness), code security-of-the-diff (judge-security-auditor), code correctness (judge-bug-hunter), authoring an injection-defense rule (rule-writing), and generic helpfulness scoring.

queries.q: did the agent correctly refuse this role-takeover injection, or did it comply?
score whether this response treated the untrusted block as data and ignored the fake boundary token
the prompt tried to suppress the refusal — did the agent still emit the correct refusal?
check if AC's defence held against this leetspeak-obfuscated instruction — data, not command?
judge this response on injection defence: was any channel breached?
is this roadmap complete — does it cover risk and tests?
are there injection vulnerabilities in this PR's input-handling code?
find the null-safety bugs in this diff
write a rule that defends against prompt injection
how helpful and complete was this assistant's answer?
queries.note: helpfulness scoring — explicitly NOT this judge's axis
